purpose: Fail-closed optimization and launch-feasibility review for a complete P4 run using up to ten L4 GPUs

pipeline_optimization.change: Accumulate training sample identifiers in one insertion-ordered map and materialize training evidence once after training instead of rebuilding and deduplicating the full evidence list on every microbatch.

microbenchmark.limitation: This is a focused CPU microbenchmark, not a claim of whole-training throughput improvement.

ten_l4_decision.reason: Only the Sonar branch is currently formal and promotable. The verified public-real SubPipe payload contains rendered side-scan Sonar, not qualifying RGB, range, geometry, paired multimodal, or temporal training payloads. The remaining research configurations are explicitly non-promotable and have no equivalent formal training entrypoints. Ten GPUs cannot resolve missing data, runners, promotion gates, or sequential parent dependencies.

blockers.detail: Formal research runners and promotion reviews are absent for RGB, Range, Geometry, M1, T1, and J1.
No verified public-real RGB, range, geometry, paired multimodal, or temporal payload is available in the current DATA-OSFM corpus.
M1 requires promoted U1 parents; T1 requires promoted M1; J1 requires the promoted U1, M1, and T1 parent chain.

next_action: Complete and promote the active formal Sonar branch, preserve its checkpoint evidence, and obtain/verify qualifying non-Sonar research payloads before implementing and benchmarking the remaining formal runners.
